/**
 * Wait for elements to exist using MutationObserver
 */
const observer = new MutationObserver((_, obs) => {
    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile_menu3');
    const blogContainer = document.querySelector('.load-more-blogs');
    const button = document.querySelector('.load-more-blogs-btn');
	const vacantContainer = document.querySelector('.positions-vacant');

    // Run menu logic
    if (mobileMenu) initMobileMenu(mobileMenu);

    // Run blog logic
    if (blogContainer && button) initLoadMore(blogContainer, button);
	
	// Run vacant position message logic
	if (vacantContainer) initVacantPositionMessage(vacantContainer);

    // Stop observing once everything is initialized
    if (mobileMenu && blogContainer && button && vacantContainer) {
        obs.disconnect();
    }
});

observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

/**
 * Mobile Menu Toggle
 */
function initMobileMenu(mobileMenu) {
    const parents = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll(
        'li.menu-item-has-children, li.et_mobile_menu_parent'
    );	

    parents.forEach(parent => {
        const link = parent.querySelector('a');
        if (!link || parent.querySelector('.submenu-toggle')) return;

        const arrow = document.createElement('span');
        arrow.className = 'submenu-toggle';
        arrow.textContent = '5';

        link.appendChild(arrow);

        arrow.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            const submenu = parent.querySelector('ul.sub-menu');
            if (!submenu) return;

            submenu.classList.toggle('open');
            arrow.textContent = submenu.classList.contains('open') ? '3' : '5';
        });
    });
}

/**
 * Load More Blogs
 */
function initLoadMore(container, button) {
    const posts = container.querySelectorAll('.et_pb_post');
    const perClick = 4;
    let visible = perClick;

	if (posts.length <= visible) {
		button.style.display = 'none';
	}
	
    // Hide all first
    posts.forEach(post => (post.style.display = 'none'));

    // Show initial batch
    showPosts(posts, 0, visible);

    button.addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.preventDefault();

        const next = visible + perClick;
        showPosts(posts, visible, next);

        visible = next;

        if (visible >= posts.length) {
            button.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
}

function showPosts(posts, start, end) {
    posts.forEach((post, i) => {
        if (i >= start && i < end) {
            post.style.display = 'flex';
            post.style.opacity = 0;
            post.style.transition = 'opacity 0.4s ease';

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                post.style.opacity = 1;
            });
        }
    });
}
	
/**
 * No Vacant Positions change message
 */
let vacantUpdated = false;
function initVacantPositionMessage(container) {
	if (vacantUpdated) return;
	
    const title = container.querySelector('.entry h1');
    const text = container.querySelector('.entry h1 + p');

    if (!title || !text) return false
	
    // Change content
    title.textContent = 'There are currently no vacancies with Mornington Shire Council.';

    // Make visible
    title.style.visibility = 'visible';
    text.style.display = 'none';

	vacantUpdated = true;
}

/**
 * Resource Library Filter
 */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('document-filter');
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.document-filter-item');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('no-documents-result');

    if (!input) return;

    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const filter = input.value.toLowerCase();
        let visibleCount = 0;

        items.forEach(item => {
            const text = item
                .querySelector('.et_pb_text_inner')
                ?.innerText.toLowerCase() || '';

            const match = text.includes(filter);
            item.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';

            if (match) visibleCount++;
        });

        if (noResults) {
            noResults.style.display = visibleCount ? 'none' : 'block';
        }
    });
});
